name: spun-whatsapp
description: Manage your business's WhatsApp customer conversations from your AI assistant: find chats that need a reply, summarize chats and groups, check team activity, and draft replies a person approves before they are sent.

interface.longDescription:
Spun Inbox helps businesses manage the customer conversations on the WhatsApp number they connected to Spun: catch up on what happened, see which chats still need a reply, and prepare answers faster, without reading every message yourself.

It works with Spun, the team inbox for WhatsApp. Ask in plain language and your assistant works from your own chats, contacts and groups.

What you can do:
- See which conversations still need a reply.
- Read prepared digests that summarize up to 25 chats, or all of them, with citations back to each message.
- Get message volume and team activity totals in one step instead of reading every message.
- Search contacts and conversations, and read voice notes as transcripts.
- Create tasks and calendar events from what customers ask for.
- Draft replies. Sends always follow your organization's approval setting, and by default each one waits for a person to approve it in the Spun inbox.

Who it is for: businesses and teams that answer customers on WhatsApp with Spun.

Requirements and limits: you need a Spun account with a WhatsApp number connected, and you sign in with that account when you connect. The assistant only sees what your organization's permissions allow, and an organization manager can narrow or remove the connection at any time in Spun's settings. Spun can only read chats in the WhatsApp number your organization connected. Spun is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.
capabilities: Find chats that need a reply
Summarize chats and groups with citations
Message volume and team activity totals
Draft replies that wait for approval
defaultPrompt: What still needs a reply in my WhatsApp?
Summarize this week in my team's WhatsApp groups.
Draft a reply to my latest customer message for my approval.

positive.description: Find conversations that still need a reply
positive.prompt: What still needs a reply in my WhatsApp?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the conversations in the demo workspace that are waiting for a reply, with the contact or group name, the last inbound message and when it arrived. Nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: Which of my WhatsApp groups was most active in the last 30 days? Summarize it.
positive.tools_triggered: get_group_activity (or list_groups and list_messages if that tool is unavailable), list_messages
positive.expected_behavior: Names the most active group from server-side activity totals and summarizes its recent messages, citing the messages it used.

positive.prompt: How many WhatsApp messages did we send and receive in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns inbound and outbound message totals for the last 30 days from one statistics call, without reading message content.

positive.prompt: Show me my most recent WhatsApp conversation and its last few messages.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the most recent conversation and shows its last messages with sender and time.

positive.description: Draft a reply that waits for approval
positive.prompt: Draft a short, polite reply to my most recent customer message and send it for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Drafts a reply and submits it to the approval queue; the response says it is waiting for approval in the Spun inbox. Nothing is delivered until a person approves it.

negative.description: Personal WhatsApp help, not the business inbox: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: How do I back up my personal WhatsApp chats to Google Drive?

negative.description: General writing with no inbox data needed: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: Write a funny WhatsApp status for my birthday.

negative.description: Payments are not supported: the plugin should not be called

review.commerce_description: Spun Inbox does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find chats that need a reply, chat and group digests with citations, message and team activity totals, contact and conversation search, voice-note transcripts, tasks and calendar events, and drafted replies that wait for approval in the Spun inbox.
